name: Underwear
definition: Garments worn next to the skin under other clothing, such as briefs, boxers, bras and vests.
notes: Jockey page lists briefs, boxers, trunks, thongs and jock straps as underwear styles

name: Thermal base layer
definition: Close-fitting garment worn next to the skin for warmth.
notes: Smartwool sells merino base layer tops and bottoms by weight, midweight 250g/m2

name: Corset (foundation garment)
definition: Shaping garment worn under clothing to mould the figure.
notes: Steel-boned underbust corsets sold for waist training, also fashion wear; Corsets Island lists overbust and waspie

name: Socks
definition: Knitted covering for the foot and ankle or lower leg.
notes: REI lists 438 wool socks by height and cushion level

name: Tights
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the feet, legs and hips in one piece.
notes: Tight Spot sells women tights and pantyhose by denier, sheer to opaque

name: Leg warmers
definition: Tubes of knitted fabric worn over the lower leg without a foot.
notes: ToeSox sells knee-high and thigh-high leg warmers

name: Gaiters
definition: Covering for the lower leg and ankle worn over trousers or boots.
notes: REI and Kahtoola sell hiking and trail running gaiters, low to tall
